description: In UFS Field Firmware Update (FFU) functionality, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to missing bounds checking on the PRDT table size. This could lead to local code execution or denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed.

In Modem Firmware, there is a possible system crash due to improper input validation of dedicated PUCCH configuration. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed.

In the bootloader download module, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to a failure to reset a global offset variable during firmware update sessions.
